about_the_game:
PKWAR: Text-Based Battle Royale MUD

Every war. Everyone starts equal. Only knowledge wins.

Welcome to PKWAR - a PvP MUD where 15-minute matches deliver intense, skill-based combat. No grinding. No gear advantages. Just you, your wits, and other players fighting for supremacy.

WHAT MAKES PKWAR DIFFERENT:

⚔️ True Competitive Equality - Every match starts fresh. No player has equipment advantages. Veterans win through map knowledge and tactics alone.

⏱️ 15-Minute Matches - Quick, intense battles that fit your schedule. No 8-hour grinding sessions required.

🎮 Battle Royale Meets MUD - Spawn with nothing, scavenge equipment, hunt other players. Last warrior standing wins.

🗺️ 2100+ Room Battleground - Master the massive map to find the best loot spawns, ambush points, and puzzles. Knowledge is power.

🎯 Multiple Game Modes:

  • Free-for-all bloodbaths

  • Strategic team warfare

  • "Best vs Rest" enforcer hunts

PROGRESSION & FEATURES:

📈 Skill-Based Ranking - Rise from Private to Captain through victories alone 🏆 46 Steam Achievements - Including hidden challenges 💰 Match Rewards - Earn credits through performance 🧙 Become an Implementor - Top players at level 10 can shape the game world 🎲 Dynamic Elements - Random weapon spawns and shifting maze exits keep every match fresh

PERFECT FOR:

  • Competitive gamers seeking pure skill-based PvP

  • MUD veterans wanting fast-paced action

  • Battle royale fans ready for a text-based challenge

  • Anyone tired of pay-to-win and grinding

No graphics. No distractions. Just pure, tactical combat where your mind is your greatest weapon.

Join now via Steam client or connect directly: pkwar . org port 2222

content_descriptors.notes: This is an online player-killing mud (multi user dungeon).  You will obtain weapons and unique items to meet new people, and hunt them down and kill them.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: 1 GHz x86_64 processor
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires active internet connection to play on PKWAR server
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or latest SteamOS
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual core x86_64
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any modern graphics card with open source drivers
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio or PipeWire
  • Additional Notes: Native Linux client available

short_description: Enter the arena in PKWAR, a hardcore PvP MUD where text-based combat meets competitive glory. Choose from 5 unique classes, battle players simultaneously, and rise through military ranks from Private to Captain. No graphics, no distractions - just pure skill-based combat. Death or glory.
